note: Hoi An shophouse blocks (hoi_an_shophouses_a/b.glb: 20 m of 1-2 storey houses side by side, front facing +Z before yaw, bodies 12 m deep). Each row: from -> to every step metres, yaw in degrees (0 faces the river to the south, 180 faces north). Rows leave room for the square, the cross streets, the Fujian Assembly Hall and Quan Cong temple on Tran Phu (landmarks.json) and the central market. HoiAnZones.lots("shophouses_a" / "shophouses_b") alternates the two variants along every row.
